scope: Unobserved capture dates of recurring fixture/specimen families; not new-product generalization
rationale: Only current folder available; the large broad similarity families are retained as overlap diagnostics, not claimed independent
grouping: all cameras of the same calendar date together; merge dates linked by same-dimension whole corr>=.995 AND product corr>=.995
tuning: all dates/groups containing preprocessing pilot source IDs forced to train
allocation: Exhaustive two-way partition of untouched groups; target val70/test70; balance camera and box-count categories; use no detector scores
rule: Require every camera in both validation and test; deterministic lexicographic tie-break
validation_use: model/threshold selection; test list locked until selections complete
limitation: Shared scene/fixture family overlap remains; preprocessing was tuned on that broad family; this split is for internal comparison only
